pins.definition: Each of the five long parts at the end of the hand.

situation: A person at a wooden workbench points precisely at a detail on an old mechanical watch movement with one extended digit.
subject: the extended finger
brief: A clean view of a human hand resting on a dark wooden surface, with one finger extended straight and clear in the center of the frame.
prompt: A clean view of a human hand resting on a dark wooden surface, with one finger extended straight and clear in the center of the frame. a nineteenth-century engraved scientific plate, fine hatching, hand-tinted washes, aged rag paper, the specimen isolated and reverently observed. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
